About this experiment

One shared matrix E embeds both operands and reads the answer. Concatenating [E[a], E[b]] and projecting with A preserves operand order, followed by four own-channel ReLU layers. All three roles of E share one AdamW state.

What counts as grokking?

Five consecutive observations with training accuracy ≥99% and held-out accuracy ≤10%, followed by held-out accuracy ≥99%.

Seed 7, Rust/CUDA: train ≥99% at epoch 425, held-out ≥99% at epoch 1,300. WASM SIMD: held-out ≥99% at epoch 1,275. This is gradual generalization with a delay; it did not meet the strict plateau criterion. Fifty epochs were insufficient. Browser arithmetic and seeds can change the trajectory.

One architecture, two widths

Both tabs use the same shared-E Rotate90 Square Neighbor residual architecture and default seed 11. Only channel width changes: 128 channels / 13,952 parameters, or 1024 / 111,616. The narrow model generalizes directly; the wide model shows a memorization plateau on all five tested Rust seeds. Tabs retain separate weights, optimizer state and curves; switching pauses the previous model. Training begins from random initialization on your device.
